quiz.title: Class 12 Maths Test Series Quiz
quiz.intro: Eight mixed questions sampling the CBSE Class 12 board syllabus — calculus, algebra, vectors and 3D, probability and LPP. Pick an answer for each, then press Check my score.

questions.q: The value of ∫ 2x · e<sup>x²</sup> dx is:
questions.explanation: Put t = x², so dt = 2x dx. The integral becomes ∫ e<sup>t</sup> dt = e<sup>t</sup> + C = e<sup>x²</sup> + C.

questions.q: If A is a 3×3 matrix with |A| = 4, then |2A| equals:
questions.explanation: For an n×n matrix, |kA| = k<sup>n</sup>|A|. Here n = 3, so |2A| = 2³ × 4 = 8 × 4 = 32.

questions.q: The derivative of sin<sup>-1</sup>x with respect to x is:
If vectors a = 2i + 3j + k and b = i − j + 2k, then a · b equals:
The distance of the point (1, 2, 3) from the origin is:
A die is thrown once. The probability of getting a number greater than 4 is:
questions.explanation: Numbers greater than 4 are 5 and 6, giving 2 favourable outcomes out of 6. So the probability is 2/6 = 1/3.

questions.q: The general solution of the differential equation dy/dx = y is:
questions.explanation: Separate variables: dy/y = dx. Integrating gives ln|y| = x + C, so y = Ce<sup>x</sup>.

questions.q: In a linear programming problem, the optimal value of the objective function, if it exists, always occurs at:
options: the centre of the feasible region
a corner (vertex) of the feasible region
questions.explanation: By the corner-point theorem, the maximum or minimum of a linear objective function over a bounded feasible region occurs at one of its corner points (vertices).

faq.q: What topics does a Class 12 Maths test series cover?
faq.a: A complete test series spans the whole CBSE syllabus — relations and functions, inverse trigonometry, matrices and determinants, continuity and differentiability, integrals and applications, differential equations, vectors, three-dimensional geometry, linear programming and probability.

faq.q: How often should I take a full-length Class 12 Maths test?
faq.a: Once the chapters are covered, aim for one full-length timed paper a week. Regular timed practice builds speed and exposes weak areas well before the board exam, when there is still time to fix them.

faq.q: Which chapters carry the most weight in the Class 12 board exam?
faq.a: Calculus — continuity, differentiation, integrals and their applications — carries the largest share, usually around a third of the paper. Algebra (matrices and determinants), vectors and 3D geometry, and probability make up most of the rest.

faq.q: How should I use test papers to prepare, not just check answers?
faq.a: Sit each paper under exam conditions with a timer, then review every mistake and redo those questions a few days later. The second attempt on missed questions is where marks are actually gained.
